key_insight: DeHNSSo-v2 extends nonlinear flow-stability analysis to compressible flows and curved geometries while delivering approximately 10× speed-up on DeHNSSo-v1 nonlinear test cases.
engineering_relevance: The solver supports boundary-layer transition and flow-control studies involving compressibility, complex surfaces, and metamaterials.
method: Compressible harmonic Navier–Stokes formulation on body-fitted 2D grids with fourth-order spatial accuracy.
Automatic grid generation, linear-cost sparse assembly, and reusable per-mode factorizations.
Newton pseudo-arclength continuation for high-amplitude nonlinear solutions.
evidence_signal: Validation includes linear boundary-layer instability benchmarks at Mach 0.5–4.5, nonlinear oblique-mode breakdown at Mach 1.6, swept-wing comparisons with DNS, and resonator-interaction comparisons with experimentally validated simulations.
watch_item: The reported speed-up applies to selected nonlinear benchmarks; performance and convergence should be checked for each geometry and harmonic resolution.
paper_title: DeHNSSo-v2: A compressible, curvilinear, and efficient extension of the Delft Harmonic Navier-Stokes Solver
